sentences.text:
Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.
Hon'ble Vivek Kumar Birla,J.
Hon'ble Kshitij Shailendra,J.
Heard learned A.G.A. appearing for the State respondents.
Perused the record.

This writ petition has been filed praying to quash the impugned First Information Report dated 21.7.2022 registered as Case Crime No. 101 of 2022, under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506 IPC, P.S.
Kotwali, District Moradabad.
Vide order dated 6.8.2022 the matter was referred to the mediation centre.

Perused the settlement agreement dated 20.1.2023 which indicates that matter has been peacefully settled between the parties and they have settled their differences on the terms mentioned in Deep Agrawal And 2 Others vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others on 15 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/126618950/
1 paragraph 7 of the settlement agreement dated 20.1.2023.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
The paragraph 7 is quoted as under:-
"7.

The following settlement has been arrived at between the Parties hereto:
a) That the parties have already settled their dispute and and in this regard they have produced a notarized 'Samjotha Anubandh' dated 30.11.2022.

The parties state that all the terms and conditions of the settlement has also been mentioned in aforesaid Samjotha Anubandh, which forms a part of the settlement also and a copy whereof is annexed herewith for kind perusal of the Hon'ble Court.
b) That the parties undertake not to commit any kind of cruelty against each other in any manner whatsoever.
c) That it has been agreed between the parties that they will behave properly living in peaceful and cordial atmosphere.
d) That the husband and wife undertake that they shall not take any such action which may hurt either of the party mentally or physically and shall try to satisfy each other by their activities.
e) That the husband undertakes to take care of his wife and fulfill all essential requirements and amenities to her in future.

f) That it has also been agreed between the parties that all the cases filed by them against each other and their family members regarding present matrimonial dispute shall be withdrawn by the parties concerned by taking appropriate steps before the Court/authority concerned.
g) That the parties will not file any fresh case against each other in respect of this matrimonial dispute.
They have no claim against each other in future also.
h) That it has been agreed between the parties that they shall not violate the terms and conditions of this settlement otherwise the aggrieved party will be free to take legal recourse."

It is submitted that as between the parties compromise had already taken place therefore, the impugned First Information Report dated 21.7.2022 registered as Case Crime No. 101 of 2022,
under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506 IPC, P.S. Kotwali, District Moradabad is liable to be quashed.

Thus, in view of the well settled principles of law as laid down by the Hon'ble Apex Court reported in 2003(4) SCC 675 (B.S. Joshi Vs. State of Haryana), J.T. 2008(9) SC 192 (Nikhil Merchant Vs.
Central Bureau of investigation and another), (2012) 10 SCC 303 (Gian Singh Vs. State of Punjab),
(2014) 9 SCC 653 (Yogendra Yadav and others Vs. State of Jharkhand) and also (2014) 6 SCC 466 (Narendra Singh Vs. State of Punjab), and in view of the settlement agreement dated 20.1.2023, the Deep Agrawal And 2 Others vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others on 15 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/126618950/
